instruction: Candid medium wide photograph of friends celebrating on a rooftop terrace. From left to right, a man with a bun (R5) in a black shirt claps, a bald man with glasses (R6) in a white t-shirt raises his hands high, a blonde woman (R1) in a striped jumpsuit laughs while holding a cupcake, a man with a white cap (R2) in a white t-shirt cheers with raised hands, a woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a black top claps, a dark-haired woman (R3) in a striped crop top claps, and a curly-haired woman (R7) in a striped dress claps. The scene is brightly lit by natural daylight.
